field.name: fruugo_category_id
field.help: Optional: Map this specific product. This overrides the ProductCategory mapping.

field.name: fruugo_brand
field.help: Leave blank to use product internal category name as fallback.

field.name: fruugo_ean_exception
field.help: Tick if you are the manufacturer and have no EAN/barcode. Exports 'EXCEP'.

field.name: fruugo_excluded
field.help: Tick to prevent this product from appearing in any Fruugo feed.

field.name: fruugo_lead_time
field.help: Days from order to dispatch (INSTOCK items). Only fill if more than 1 day.

field.name: fruugo_country_restriction
field.help: Space-separated ISO country codes to restrict this product. Leave blank for no restriction.
